spec.description: A standard or specification defining the item: anyone may deliver it to that specification. An on-chain asset is spec:caip19; a national currency, spec:iso4217

issuer.description: The issuer or obligor: the right is its obligation

registry.description: The external registry where the right or object is recorded

place.description: Place: the naming authority and the id within it

route.description: Route: origin and destination, all four fields

period.description: Period [start, end) in UTC POSIX microseconds

window.description: Start window in UTC POSIX microseconds

deadline.description: Completion deadline in UTC POSIX microseconds — a stated condition, not a check

capacity.description: Concurrent capacity: unit and a positive count

object.description: A specific object: serial, cadastral or registry number

families.name: National cash currencies
families.identity: The currency and essential requirements on the cash form; a collectible specimen is a separate Unique asset.

families.name: Money obligation paid by bank transfer
families.identity: The currency and the exact payment item; the payee's details do not make a new currency.

families.name: Bank deposit claim
families.identity: The specific bank, issue/contract, currency, term and assignment conditions.

families.name: Electronic money

families.name: Central bank digital money

families.name: Cash claim on a broker or custodian
